cues.speaker: Harry
cues.en: There you are, Gillian.

cues.speaker: Harry
cues.en: I've restored Little John's memory chip.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Was there anything on it?

cues.speaker: Harry
cues.en: Hold your horses. I'll play it now. Watch the monitor.

cues.speaker: Harry
cues.en: His memory was damaged almost beyond repair.

cues.speaker: Harry
cues.en: Those Snatchers knew what they were doing.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: So there was nothing left?

cues.speaker: Harry
cues.en: Wait, don't rush me. I managed to restore one scene. Just the picture.

cues.speaker: Harry
cues.en: I don't know what it means,

cues.speaker: Harry
cues.en: but it's definitely something Jean witnessed.

cues.speaker: Harry
cues.en: Ready? Here it is!

cues.speaker: Harry
cues.en: Know what that is, Gillian?

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Hospital OLEEN. Oleen Hospital?

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Could this be the hospital Gibson found?

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: The one occupied by the Snatchers?

cues.speaker: Harry
cues.en: Try looking it up in Gaudi.

cues.speaker: Harry
cues.en: But if it's unlicensed, you can't count on the records.

cues.speaker: Harry
cues.en: Neo Kobe is full of underground hospitals.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Maybe the sign curves around and there's more after OLEEN.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: I've saved the image. You can view it anytime.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Select Video memory from your inventory.
